desc: Ideate linear-time approaches for finding the longest palindromic suffix of S.
Implement the full Python solution using KMP with pattern R = S[::-1], compute the prefix function for R, scan S to obtain L, and output S + S[:n-L][::-1].
Verify the implementation on samples and edge cases; sample tests passed and the KMP logic handles palindromic, non-palindromic, and single-character cases.
No fallback approach needed; the KMP solution is O(n) time and O(n) memory within the constraints.
